description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join an early-stage, Y Combinator-backed AI marketing automation startup as a Founding Engineer (Full-Stack). You'll be one of the first engineers on the team, taking full ownership of features from concept through deployment — working directly with founders and customers to shape the product and infrastructure from the ground up.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own end-to-end feature development across the full stack: frontend (Vue.js/Nuxt), backend (Node.js/TypeScript), and AI agent integrations (LangGraph)

 - Architect and maintain robust PostgreSQL database schemas using Supabase, ensuring data integrity and performance

 - Manage deployments, background jobs, and infrastructure using Render and Inngest; maintain dedicated deployments on Microsoft Azure

 - Apply user-centric design thinking across the full product lifecycle

 - Collaborate closely with the operations team and customers (via Slack and Notion) to align technical solutions with real user needs

 - Contribute to tooling and internal workflows using Linear, GitHub, Slack, and Notion


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Required:

 - 2+ years of professional software engineering experience delivering full-stack web applications

 - Hands-on experience with TypeScript and Node.js backend development

 - Strong proficiency with PostgreSQL and relational database design

 - Frontend experience with Vue.js + Nuxt, or React/Next.js

 - Experience owning features end-to-end — from concept through deployment to maintenance

 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

 - Willing and able to relocate to San Francisco and work on-site

Nice to Have:

 - Experience deploying and managing applications with Render and Inngest; familiarity with Microsoft Azure

 - Background or exposure to marketing technology or AdTech

 - Experience integrating with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, etc.) or building AI/ML-powered features

 - Familiarity with serverless workflows or event-driven architecture


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

 - Salary: $175,000 – $200,000 USD annually

 - Equity as a founding team member

 - Visa sponsorship available


LOCATION

This role is on-site in San Francisco, CA. Candidates must be willing and able to work from the San Francisco office full-time. Relocation support is available.
